Loved the way the Raptors played, gone are the days of empty isolation attempts from 43 and 23.

The front office can see what this team is capable of without their 2 stars and key rotation players. This team is right there, they’re together, they fight for one another, they celebrate one another, and they’re willing to learn on the fly from top to bottom. They’re only getting better game by game. 

We are finally witnessing a team that has a bright future. There’s excitement and anticipation for upcoming games because we want to see their growth. 

I believe Masai can see what he has with this team and he will take the appropriate steps to improve this roster for playoff contention.

I’m not saying this is a championship contending team, but they need to experience the playoffs to grow. The environment, the way the pace of the game slows down. Facing one team in a 7 game series, just to see the adjustments both teams make to win.

I would not be surprised if the front office makes a win now move and the Raptors are the 8th seed by the end of the season.
